user_input: Give me a 3 day travel itinerary for Houston, Texas!
model_output:
Sure! Here's a possible 3-day itinerary for Houston, Texas:
Day 1:
* Start your day with a visit to the Space Center Houston, the official visitors center of NASA's Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center. The Space Center offers a variety of interactive exhibits, live demonstrations, and behind-the-scenes tours.
* After lunch, head to the Downtown Houston area to visit the Houston Museum of Natural Science. The museum features a vast collection of dinosaur fossils, a space science exhibit, and much more.
* In the evening, take a stroll along the Buffalo Bayou and enjoy the scenic views of the city skyline. You can also stop by the Bayou Bend Collection and Gardens, a historic house and gardens located along the bayou.
Day 2:
* Start your day with a visit to the Houston Zoo, which is home to over 6,000 animals from around the world.
* After lunch, head to the Montrose neighborhood to visit the Menil Collection, a private collection of art from the 20th and 21st centuries. The collection includes works by artists such as Picasso, Matisse, and Warhol.
* In the evening, grab dinner at one of Houston's many excellent restaurants, such as the popular Underbelly or the upscale Oxbow 7.
Day 3:
* Start your day with a visit to the National Museum of African American History and Culture, which is located in the Museum District. The museum features exhibits on the African American experience in the United States.
* After lunch, head to the Downtown Houston area to visit the Theater District, which is home to eight major performing arts organizations. You can catch a show at one of the theaters, take a backstage tour, or simply enjoy the beautiful architecture.
* In the evening, take a stroll along the Houston Strand, a pedestrian-friendly street in the Historic Strand District that is filled with shops, restaurants, and bars.
I hope this itinerary helps you plan your trip to Houston!
